overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the April 27 notice for the remanded Heritage Plantation parking project gave sufficient topic specificity, and the Committee need not list tangential topics.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 27 notice was too vague because it did not say the parking project would involve paving or landscaping, despite the RHDC remand on the parking lot.
allegations.key_passage: This was sufficient to notify members of the public that the Committee would be reconsidering the earlier discussions.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice was deficient because it did not disclose that work would also occur at a separate property on Pocasset Road in Sandwich.
allegations.key_passage: the Open Meeting Law does not require public bodies to list all tangential topics related to a project.
